summary: Example: passing a non-string (a list or dict) to from_yaml or from_yaml_all is silently ignored and now warns, removed in 2.23; make sure the input is a string.
questions: 'The from_yaml filter ignored non-string input', what does that mean?
Can I pass a dict to from_yaml_all?

answer_card.title: from_yaml needs string input
answer_card.answer_md: `from_yaml` / `from_yaml_all` on a list or dict warns that **non-string input was ignored**. Only pass strings (e.g. file content or `stdout`); if the value is already structured data, drop the filter. These warnings can be silenced with `deprecation_warnings = False` in `ansible.cfg`, but fixing the content is better because the behaviour is **removed in ansible-core 2.23**.
